name:
Coles Frozen Fruit Mixed
                                Berries | 500g
additional_desc:
Coles Mixed Berries 500g


Blueberries, strawberries, blackberries and raspberries
100% natural
Good source of fibre


Coles Mixed Berries are 100% natural with no added sugar. With a
                                                        colourful combination of blueberries, strawberries, blackberries
                                                        and raspberries they're a good source of fibre for healthy
                                                        digestion and a good source of Vitamin C to support a healthy
                                                        immune system.

Coles Mixed Berries are a freezer staple, picked at the peak of
                                                        freshness then snap frozen to lock in the goodness. With a
                                                        5-star health rating they're ideal for all your summer desserts,
                                                        snacks and breakfasts. Make a simple but delicious sorbet by
                                                        blending frozen Coles Mixed Berries with a little honey and
                                                        freezing until set. Or try making overnight oats by blending
                                                        rolled oats with black chia seeds and pepitas before adding
                                                        almond milk and a splash of maple syrup. Place in the fridge for
                                                        at least 4 hours or overnight then fold in some toasted almonds
                                                        and coconut flakes. Top with defrosted Coles Mixed Berries for a
                                                        wholesome and delicious breakfast or anytime treat.
dietary: High in Fibre, No Artificial Flavours or Colours, Source of Vitamin C
